visual_review.result: All reviewed samples depict rural roads and road environments; some include distant vehicles, homes, or traffic signs. No readable license plates or clearly identifiable faces were apparent at the reviewed resolution.
visual_review.scope_note: Representative visual review only; not a manual review of every image or a complete third-party rights/privacy audit.

rights_note: The Mendeley snapshot explicitly says further permission may be needed for third-party content identified in the dataset. The dataset description states images were captured in rural areas of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Keep this limitation with redistribution.
educational_fit: Can support a student project comparing pixel-level road surface, markings, puddles, potholes, and cracks in a fixed dataset. It is geographically specific and does not represent Japanese roads.
